newsitem.title: CHILE: Laboratorio Chile plans LatAm expansion.
newsitem.headline: Laboratorio Chile plans LatAm expansion.

text.p: Chile's top pharmaceuticals maker Laboratorio Chile plans to invest $150 million between now and the end of 1998 in a Latin American expansion plan, Chief Executive Officer Alfredo Andonie said.
The plan includes the purchase of an as-yet unnamed pharmaceuticals maker in Sao Paulo for about $50 million to $60 million to muscle into the Brazilian market, Andonie said.
The company also plans to strengthen its business in Argentina, Peru and its home market, while setting up "strategic associations" in Mexico and Colombia, said Andonie.
Financing for the expansion plan will come mainly from debt, although the company does not rule out a capital increase later, he told reporters at a shareholders' meeting.
"The plan is worth over $150 million for the next year and a half to two years...We trust that these projects, which we consider strategic, will come to fruition," he said.
The expected Mexican and Colombian deals will be with local companies that already have an important share in those markets.

Laboratorio Chile reported Q1 net income of 1.8 billion pesos on operating revenues of 8.6 billion pesos operating revenues, versus 762 million pesos net on operating revenues of 6.4 billion pesos in the same quarter of 1996. ((-- Santiago newsroom +56-2-6995595 x 211))
